page.layout: One block of running text in a single column. One marginal note in the left margin, beside the paragraph beginning "Obiectio". The text ends with a catchword at the right, below the last line.

main_text.head: II. Quod Iesus sit[?] semen mulieris promissum.
main_text.p: Probatio sit unicum argumentum cum prosyl-log. Quia in Iesu nostro, Dei ac Mariæ filio, omnia prophetarum oracula, de Messiæ persona, familia: parentibus: tempore: loco natali: do-ctrina, miraculis, morte resurrectione & benefi-ciis impleta sunt. [?]Addatur major: & subjiciatur minoris probatio per partes singulas: ac ponantur primo oracula: deinde ostendatur impletio.
1. Persona. Debuit esse verus Deus: Gen.3. Conteret caput serp. Ief.7. Emmanuel. Ief.9. Deus fortis. Ier.23. Iehova iustitia nostra.
Et verus atque iustus homo ex virgine semen mulieris. Ecce virgo, servus meus iustus.
Talis vero solus Christus Iesus, Roman.cap. 9. Deus benedictus. 1.Iohan.cap.5. Hic est verus Deus: Fructus ventris tui: Hebr. 2. Particeps carnis & sanguinis. Assumsit semen Abrahæ. Ergo, &c.
II. Familia: Tribus Iuda: stirps Davidis. Gen.49. Donec venerit Schilo, filius eius. Ief.11. Stirps Iesse virgam produxit.
Hinc Messias passim David: filius Davidis, &c.
Impletio: Iesus filius Mariæ filiæ Davidis, Luc.2: Ex semine Davidis secundum carnem. Rom.1. Vicit leo Iuda. Apoc.5.
III. Parentes. Mater virgo, ignara viri: quia Messias tantum mulieris non etiam viri semen. Ief.7. virgo concipiet.
Iren.lib.3. cap.24.Obiectio: Non virgo: sed juvencula nova nupta. Respon. העלמה[?] significat virginem a latendo. Item:

page.notes: The head "sit" may read "fit"; the long s is uncertain. The running head's last letter is unclear and may be Æ or C. The printer's mark before "Addatur" is a symbol I could not read; it is marked [?]. The Hebrew word after "Respon." is read as העלמה with doubt. The word "Iren.lib.3." is printed in the left margin. "Iesse" and "Ief." are copied as printed. The catchword "Item:" is printed at the right foot. Ink and paper damage on the lower left may hide small letters.
